description: A navigation menu that covers the whole screen, for site links on small viewports.
overview:
Fullscreen menu is built on the Base UI Dialog. The `FullscreenMenu` root manages the open state, and `FullscreenMenuTrigger` renders a menu button whose two-line icon animates into a close icon. `FullscreenMenuContent` covers the viewport and reveals from the top, with a sticky header that holds the close button. Inside it, `FullscreenMenuTitle` names the menu, `FullscreenMenuGroup` holds a list of `FullscreenMenuLink` items, and `FullscreenMenuLabel` adds a caption to a group. Links and labels fade in with a staggered delay as the menu opens.

Use it for the primary navigation of a website on phones, like the global navigation on apple.com. For a short list of actions, use a dropdown menu; for a panel that keeps part of the page visible, use a drawer or sheet.
usage:
The menu is uncontrolled by default; set `defaultOpen` to start open, or control it with `open` and `onOpenChange`. Choosing a `FullscreenMenuLink` closes the menu. Set `isActive` on the link for the current page.

Groups that contain a `FullscreenMenuLabel` render their links smaller than groups without one, so the first group reads as primary navigation. Use `FullscreenMenuLink` with the `render` prop to render a router link instead of an anchor.

examples.LinksOnly: A menu with a single group of primary links and no labelled sections.
examples.WithCloseLabel: A menu whose close button shows the text `Done` instead of an icon.

parts.FullscreenMenu: The root that manages the menu's open state.
parts.FullscreenMenuTrigger: The menu button, with an icon that animates between menu and close states.
parts.FullscreenMenuContent: The full-screen panel, with a sticky header that holds the close button.
parts.FullscreenMenuTitle: The menu's title, visually hidden and used as its accessible name.
parts.FullscreenMenuGroup: A list of links, animated in sequence.
parts.FullscreenMenuLabel: A caption for a group of links.
parts.FullscreenMenuLink: A navigation link that closes the menu when chosen.
parts.FullscreenMenuClose: A button that closes the menu from any element.

FullscreenMenuContent.showCloseButton: Shows the header with a close button at the top of the menu.
FullscreenMenuContent.closeLabel: Replaces the close button's icon with this text.

FullscreenMenuLink.isActive: Marks the link as the current page with `aria-current="page"` and the link color.

accessibility:
- The panel has the `dialog` role and takes its name from `FullscreenMenuTitle`, which is visually hidden. Always include one.
- The trigger has no text of its own, so give it an accessible name with `aria-label`. It sets `aria-expanded` while the menu is open.
- Opening the menu moves focus inside it. Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
- The icon-only close button has a visually hidden `Close` label.
- The active link sets `aria-current="page"`.
notes:
- Styling hooks: `data-slot` values `fullscreen-menu-trigger`, `fullscreen-menu-content`, `fullscreen-menu-header`, `fullscreen-menu-body`, `fullscreen-menu-close`, `fullscreen-menu-title`, `fullscreen-menu-group`, `fullscreen-menu-label` and `fullscreen-menu-link`.
- The active link gets `data-active`.
- The stagger delay is computed from a link's position in its group, for up to 10 links, and the group's position in the menu, for up to 6 sections.
- The content respects safe-area insets, and animations are disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
- Uses the `surface`, `label`, `label-secondary` and `link` tokens.
